questions.prompt: Laravel'da route, controller va Blade qanday bog'langan?

options.text: `routes/web.php` da URL → controller metod (`Route::get('/users/{id}', [UserController::class, 'show'])`); controller so'rovni ishlab, ma'lumotni `view('users.show', compact('user'))` bilan Blade shabloniga uzatadi; Blade — `{{ $user->name }}` (avtomatik escape), direktivalar (`@foreach`, `@if`), layout (`@extends`/`@yield` yoki komponentlar)

options.hint: Mumkin, lekin Blade — shablon qatlami, ajratish uchun.
Kichik loyihada mumkin; controller — tashkil qilish va cache (`route:cache` closure bilan ishlamaydi... 8.x+ ishlaydi, lekin konvensiya controller).
Server tomonidagi PHP shablon dvigateli.

questions.explanation: `{{ }}` — `htmlspecialchars` (XSS himoya), `{!! !!}` — xom (ehtiyot). Resource controller (`Route::resource`) — 7 standart metod. Route model binding: `{user}` → `User $user` avtomatik (404 topilmasa). `php artisan route:list` — barcha marshrutlar.

questions.prompt: Laravel migratsiyalari nima uchun kerak va qanday ishlaydi?

options.text: DB sxemasini kod sifatida versiyalash: `php artisan make:migration`, `up()`/`down()` metodlari Schema builder bilan (`$table->string('name')`), `migrate` — bajarilmaganlarni ketma-ket ishlatadi (`migrations` jadvalida kuzatadi), `migrate:rollback` — orqaga; jamoa va muhitlar bir xil sxema

options.hint: Sxema o'zgarishi, ma'lumot ko'chirish emas (seeder — test ma'lumot).
Har sxema o'zgarishi — yangi migratsiya.
Laravel'da auto-sync yo'q — migratsiya aniq.

questions.explanation: Qoidalar: production'da bajarilgan migratsiyani o'zgartirmaslik (yangisini yozish), `migrate:fresh` — faqat lokal (hamma jadvalni o'chiradi), `down()` to'g'ri yozish, katta jadvalda indeks qo'shish — DB'ga xos (`concurrently` — xom SQL). Seeder + factory — test ma'lumot.

questions.prompt: Quyidagi controller kodida qanday muammolar bor?
questions.code:
<?php
class UserController extends Controller {
    public function store(Request $request) {
        $user = new User();
        $user->name = $request->name;
        $user->email = $request->email;
        $user->password = $request->password;
        $user->save();
        return redirect('/users');
    }
}

options.text: Validatsiya yo'q (`$request->validate()` yoki Form Request); parol hash'lanmagan (`Hash::make` yoki model cast `hashed`); `$request->name` — `input()`/`validated()` orqali aniqroq; mass assignment `User::create($request->validated())` + `$fillable` bilan qisqaroq

options.hint: Farqi kichik; asosiy muammo validatsiya va hash.
POST'dan keyin redirect — to'g'ri (PRG pattern).
Bo'sh email yoki ochiq parol bilan nima bo'ladi?

questions.explanation: Form Request: `php artisan make:request StoreUserRequest` — `rules()` + `authorize()`, controller `store(StoreUserRequest $request)` — validatsiya avtomatik, xato — redirect back with errors (yoki JSON 422). Laravel 10+: `'password' => 'hashed'` cast. `$guarded`/`$fillable` — mass assignment himoyasi.

questions.prompt: Laravel'da `artisan` nima va eng ko'p ishlatiladigan buyruqlar qaysilar?

options.text: CLI vosita: `make:*` (controller, model, migration, request, job), `migrate`, `db:seed`, `route:list`, `tinker` (REPL), `config:cache`/`route:cache`/`view:cache` (production), `queue:work`, `schedule:run`, `test`; o'z buyruqlar — `make:command`

options.hint: `serve` — bitta buyruq; o'nlab generator va boshqaruv buyruqlari.
Composer — paketlar; artisan — ilova buyruqlari (Symfony Console ustida).
CLI.

questions.explanation: Production deploy: `composer install --no-dev -o`, `php artisan migrate --force`, `config:cache`, `route:cache`, `view:cache`, `event:cache`, `queue:restart`. `optimize` — bir nechta cache birga. `config:cache`dan keyin `env()` faqat config fayllarida ishlaydi — kodda `config()` ishlating.

options.text: `public/index.php` → autoload → `bootstrap/app.php` (Application) → HTTP Kernel → global middleware → router (marshrut, route middleware) → controller → Response → middleware (teskari) → `send()` → `terminate` middleware; service provider'lar `register` keyin `boot` kernel bootstrap'ida
Route → controller → view, boshqa qatlam yo'q
options.hint: Middleware, kernel, provider'lar — orasida.
Router controller'ni tanlaydi.
FPM'da har so'rov noldan bootstrap (Octane'dan tashqari).

questions.explanation: Laravel 11: `bootstrap/app.php` — middleware, routing, exception konfiguratsiyasi (Kernel klasslari yo'q). Provider `register` — faqat binding (boshqa servisni ishlatmaslik, hali tayyor emas), `boot` — hamma ro'yxatdan o'tgan. `terminate` — javob yuborilgandan keyin (log, metrika).

questions.prompt: Service container qanday ishlaydi va `bind`/`singleton`/`instance` qanday farqlanadi?

options.text: IoC container — klasslarni bog'liqliklari bilan avtomatik yig'adi (reflection, constructor type hint); `bind` — har `make`da yangi instansiya; `singleton` — bir marta (so'rov davomida); `instance` — tayyor ob'ektni ro'yxatdan o'tkazish; interfeys → implementatsiya bog'lash provider'da; contextual binding — turli joyga turli implementatsiya

options.hint: Facade — container'ga kirish usuli; container — DI yadrosi.
Konkret klasslar avtomatik (zero-config); faqat interfeys/parametr uchun binding.
FPM'da so'rov davomida; Octane'da — ilova davomida (ehtiyot!).

questions.explanation: `app()->bind(PaymentGateway::class, StripeGateway::class)`; controller `__construct(PaymentGateway $gw)` — avtomatik. Primitiv parametr (`string $apiKey`) — `->needs('$apiKey')->give(config(...))` yoki closure. Method injection — controller metodlarida ham. Testda `$this->mock(PaymentGateway::class)`.

questions.code:
<?php
class EnsureAdmin {
    public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next) {
        if (!$request->user()->isAdmin()) {
            abort(403);
        }
        $response = $next($request);
        Log::info('admin action', ['user' => $request->user()->id]);
    }
}

options.text: `$response` qaytarilmaydi — klient bo'sh javob oladi (`return $response` kerak); `$request->user()` null bo'lishi mumkin (auth middleware'siz) — `?->` yoki `auth` middleware'dan keyin; `abort` o'rniga exception/`redirect` — kontekstga qarab

options.hint: `Closure` — Laravel konvensiyasi, to'g'ri.
Log — normal; muammo qaytarishda.
Handler nima qaytaradi? Brauzerda nima ko'rinadi?

questions.explanation: Middleware shakli: oldin (`$next`dan oldin), keyin (`$next`dan keyin, `$response` bilan), yoki `terminate()` (javob yuborilgach — log uchun yaxshiroq). Middleware parametrlari: `->middleware('role:admin')` → `handle($request, $next, $role)`. Laravel 11: `bootstrap/app.php`da alias/guruhlar.

questions.prompt: Laravel Sanctum nima va u API autentifikatsiyasini qanday ta'minlaydi?

options.text: Yengil auth: (1) API token — `$user->createToken('name', ['abilities'])`, Bearer header, DB'da hash saqlanadi, mobil/uchinchi tomon uchun; (2) SPA cookie auth — Laravel sessiya + CSRF cookie, bir domen/subdomen SPA uchun (token saqlash xavfisiz); `auth:sanctum` middleware ikkalasini qo'llaydi

options.hint: Bu Passport; Sanctum — soddaroq, OAuth flow'lar yo'q.
API token ham — asosiy maqsad.
Sanctum tokenlari opaque (tasodifiy satr, DB'da), JWT emas.

questions.explanation: Tanlov: o'z SPA — Sanctum cookie (XSS'ga chidamli, `HttpOnly`); mobil — Sanctum token; uchinchi tomon ilovalar OAuth bilan — Passport; stateless mikroservis — JWT paket. Token abilities — nozik ruxsat (`$user->tokenCan('orders:read')`). Tokenlarni muddat bilan (`expiration` config) va bekor qilish (`tokens()->delete()`).

questions.prompt: Laravel service provider'larda `register` va `boot` farqi va deferred provider nima?

options.text: `register` — faqat container binding (boshqa servislarni chaqirmaslik — tartib kafolatlanmagan); `boot` — hamma provider ro'yxatdan o'tgach, servislardan foydalanish (route, event listener, view composer, macro); deferred provider (`DeferrableProvider` + `provides()`) — faqat servis so'ralganda yuklanadi (bootstrap tezlashadi)

options.hint: Ikki bosqich — tartib muammosini hal qiladi.
Router hali tayyor bo'lmasligi mumkin — `boot`da.
Ilova ham o'z provider'larini yozadi (`AppServiceProvider`, domen provider'lar).

questions.explanation: Katta ilovada provider'lar — modul chegaralari (`OrderServiceProvider`: binding + event + route). `boot`da og'ir ish (DB so'rov) — har so'rovda bajariladi, qochish. Laravel 11 `bootstrap/providers.php`. Paket auto-discovery — `composer.json` `extra.laravel.providers`.

questions.prompt: Laravel'da Facade qanday ishlaydi va uning tanqidi nimada?

options.text: Statik ko'rinishli proxy: `Cache::get()` → `__callStatic` → container'dan `cache` servisini olib metodni chaqiradi; qulay va testda `Cache::shouldReceive()` bilan mock; tanqid — bog'liqlik yashirin (imzoda ko'rinmaydi), IDE uchun ide-helper kerak, DI'ga nisbatan kamroq aniq; real-time facade (`Facades\App\Service`)

options.hint: Static emas — container'ga proxy; almashtirish va mock mumkin.
Har Facade o'rniga interfeys inject qilish mumkin — tanlov.
Nom o'xshash, mohiyat boshqa (proxy/service locator).

questions.explanation: Amaliy kelishuv: controller/service'da konstruktor DI (aniq, testlanadigan), tez prototip/helper'da Facade. `Cache::shouldReceive('get')->once()->andReturn(...)` — Mockery. Larastan Facade turlarini biladi. Octane'da Facade orqali singleton — so'rovlar orasida holat sizishiga e'tibor.

options.text: Feature test — HTTP orqali (`$this->postJson('/api/users', [...])->assertStatus(201)->assertJsonPath(...)`), `RefreshDatabase` trait (tranzaksiya/migratsiya), factory'lar (`User::factory()->create()`), `actingAs`, fake'lar (`Queue::fake()`, `Mail::fake()`, `Http::fake()`, `Event::fake()`); Unit test — sof klasslar; Pest — qisqa sintaksis, `expect()`, dataset'lar; SQLite in-memory tez, lekin production DB bilan farq

options.hint: Laravel test infratuzilmasi — eng kuchli tomonlaridan biri.
Dusk — E2E, kam; feature testlar — asosiy.

options.text: Har test uchun real tashqi API chaqirish
options.hint: `Http::fake()` — tez, deterministik.

questions.explanation: `Queue::fake()` + `Queue::assertPushed(SendEmail::class)` — job yuborilganini tekshirish, bajarmasdan. `RefreshDatabase` MySQL/Postgres'da — migratsiya bir marta + tranzaksiya. Parallel test (`--parallel`) — alohida DB'lar. Larastan + Pint CI'da testlar bilan birga.

questions.prompt: Laravel Octane nima, qanday foyda va xavf beradi?

options.text: Ilovani xotirada ushlab turadigan server (Swoole/RoadRunner/FrankenPHP) — bootstrap bir marta, so'rovlar ~10x tezroq, konkurent task'lar, tick/interval; xavf — so'rovlar orasida holat sizishi (singleton'da so'rov ma'lumoti, static property, container'ga so'rov-scoped narsa bog'lash), xotira o'sishi (worker restart), ba'zi paketlar mos emas; `--watch` dev, `max-requests` production

options.hint: Server rejimi — ilova hayot siklini o'zgartiradi.

options.text: Octane har Laravel ilovasini avtomatik tezlashtiradi, xavfsiz
options.hint: Holat sizishi — real xavf, kod audit kerak.
FPM hali ko'pchilik; Octane — ongli tanlov.

questions.explanation: Tipik Octane xatosi: `app()->singleton(CurrentTenant::class)` — birinchi so'rov tenant'i hammaga qoladi; yechim — `scoped` binding (so'rov uchun) yoki `Octane::prepareApplicationForNextRequest`. Qachon: yuqori RPS, latency muhim, jamoa tayyor. Oldin: OPcache + preloading + `config:cache` — arzon yutuq.

questions.prompt: Laravel API'ni versiyalash va evolyutsiya qilish strategiyasi qanday?

options.text: URL prefiks (`/api/v1`) yoki header versiyalash; route guruhlar + controller namespace (`V1`, `V2`); API Resource'lar (`JsonResource`) — javob shaklini modeldan ajratadi, versiya bo'yicha alohida Resource; qo'shimcha maydon — buzmaydi, o'chirish/nom o'zgarishi — yangi versiya; deprecation header va muddat; OpenAPI (Scribe/L5-Swagger) hujjat; kontrakt testlar

options.hint: Mobil ilova eski versiyasi oylab ishlatiladi — buzilish.
Versiya portlashi; faqat buzuvchi o'zgarishda.
DB sxemasi API kontrakti bo'lib qoladi — har ustun o'zgarishi klientni buzadi; Resource qatlami kerak.

questions.explanation: `JsonResource` — `toArray()` da shakl, `whenLoaded` (eager load bo'lsa), `when` shartli, `additional` meta. Pagination resurs bilan. Versiyalar orasida umumiy mantiq — service qatlami, faqat Resource/Request farq qiladi. Sunset header (RFC 8594) — eski versiya muddati.
